entrada.titulo: Verifiable decentralized identity-based meta-computing in Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT)
entrada.texto:

Verifiable Decentralized Identity-based Meta-computing in Industrial
Internet of Things (IIoT)
Kai Dinga, Tianxiu Xiea, Keke Gaia, Chennan Guoa, Liangqi Leia, Dongjue Wanga, Jing Yub,
Liehuang Zhua and Weizhi Mengc
aSchool of Cyberspace Science and Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, China,
bSchool of Information Engineering, Minzu University of China, China
cSchool of Computing and Communications, Lancaster University, United Kingdom
ARTICLE INFO
Keywords:
Decentralized identity
Verifiable registry
Meta-computing
Trustworthy authentication
Blockchain
ABSTRACT
Meta-computing in Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) has triggered a dramatic advance due to the
gigantic supports of computation power for processing complex IIoT tasks. However, users identities
are encountering security and verification issues since emerging threats derive from dynamic inter-
operations in the cross-organization context. Even though blockchain-based Decentralized Identity
(DID) is an alternative for offering a strengthened identity governance, current verifiability of DID
documents still encounters vulnerabilities due to the involvement of the less trustful third parties
that maintain the storage of binding relationships between DID identifiers and public keys. In this
paper, we propose a novelVerifiable and Searchable Decentralized Identity (VS-DID)model. We
focus on the verifiability of DID documents and propose a verifiable registry scheme that ensures
verifiable binding relationships. In order to enable efficient queries in large-scale users’ identities in
meta-computing IIoT, we develop an on-chain-off-chain query strategy that adopts a slide window
accumulator. The experimental results show that our scheme reduces aggregate proof time and
commitmenttimeby93.5%and96.5%,respectively,comparedtotheMerkleSNARKscheme,while
maintaining reasonable verification time, significantly improving the efficiency of DID registry in
large-scale IIoT environments.

resposta.resumo: O artigo apresenta o modelo Verifiable and Searchable Decentralized Identity (VS-DID) para IIoT, focado na verificação de documentos DID e em consultas eficientes em grande escala. Utiliza um registro verificável e estratégia on‑chain/off‑chain com acumulador de janela deslizante, reduzindo o tempo de prova agregada em 93,5% e o tempo de compromisso em 96,5% frente ao esquema Merkle‑SNARK, mantendo tempo de verificação razoável.

perfil.solucao: We propose a novel Verifiable and Searchable Decentralized Identity (VS-DID) model.
perfil.avaliacao: our scheme reduces aggregate proof time and commitment time by 93.5% and 96.5%, respectively, compared to the Merkle SNARK scheme, while maintaining reasonable verification time.

resposta.interpretacao: O trabalho avança o estado da arte ao combinar verificação de documentos DID com mecanismos de consulta eficientes, abordando a vulnerabilidade de terceiros que mantêm ligações entre IDs e chaves públicas. A estratégia on‑chain/off‑chain com acumulador de janela deslizante parece ser a principal inovação de desempenho.
resposta.duvidas: Como o VS‑DID lida com revogação de credenciais em tempo real? Qual o impacto da solução em dispositivos IoT com recursos limitados? Existem avaliações de privacidade frente a possíveis vazamentos de metadados nas consultas on‑chain/off‑chain?
